title: Você
summary: The Você tab (ADR 0112): who you are first, then the six settings groups. Header with photo, name and @; the account switcher when the phone has two or more accounts; Anotações; Convidar pessoas; then settings-root.

accounts.description: Accounts on this phone. The switcher section shows only when there are two or more.

openProfile.effect: Opens the current account's profile (a later spec, Seu perfil).

shareProfile.effect: Opens the system share sheet with the bipe.chat/@handle link.

openInvites.effect: Opens the invites screen (a later spec).

notes: The header never shows the Matrix ID (ADR 0112).
The trust card (Perfil de confiança, ADR 0019) sits after Anotações; it is a later spec.
Below the invite row comes settings-root (Configurações).
